scene_description: A boy wearing a red, white, and blue striped soccer uniform is running and about to kick a soccer ball on a green grass field. Other players and spectators are visible in the background.

questions.question: What is the round thing on the ground?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round black and white object near the boy's feet.

questions.question: What is the boy doing with his leg?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the boy's leg and foot and what they are doing near the ball.

questions.question: Where is the boy playing soccer?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the green ground all around the boy.

questions.question: What is the boy wearing on his body?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the clothes on the boy's body — notice the colors and stripes.

questions.question: What might happen next after the boy swings his leg?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at where the boy's foot is and where the ball is sitting right now.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever kicked a ball before?
sample_answers: I kick a ball at the park
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you played outside with a ball.
